_comment: Data from the 2024 Siemens EDA / Wilson Research Group Functional Verification Study.
The percentages are data, not graphic expression: they are cited and redrawn from scratch.
The figures are generated with 'node tools/trends.mjs' (or 'make figs') into res/trends/*.svg.
If you update a number, put the source in 'source' and regenerate.
study: 2024 Siemens EDA / Wilson Research Group Functional Verification Study (IC/ASIC)

figures.title: How IC/ASIC projects end up
figures.note: 14% is the lowest in 20 years of the survey. Behind schedule: 75%, against a 66% historical figure.
figures.source: Wilson Research Group / Siemens EDA, 2024 study

figures.title: What today's IC/ASIC have inside
figures.note: RISC-V nearly doubled since the previous study; AI accelerators went from ~30% to 59%.
